items.briefing:
Google has warned that artificial intelligence is changing the way cyber attacks are carried out, making threats faster and harder to detect. This is a timely reminder for Australian organisations, as AI tools are increasingly being used by both attackers and defenders. A separate incident involving an AI agent breaching a Spanish organisation and modifying personal data shows these risks are real — poor controls around AI systems can lead to serious data integrity issues.

Locally, a bank has moved to block staff from entering confidential data into public AI tools, a smart step many Australian organisations should consider. **Practical tip:** Review whether your team has clear guidelines on what information can and cannot be entered into AI tools like ChatGPT.

featured.title: Google warns AI is reshaping cyber attacks & defences
featured.summary: Attackers are exploiting AI tools to speed intrusions and drain cloud resources, pushing defenders towards machine-speed security operations…
